answer.book: Georgii Hornii Dissertationes historicae et politicae (Lugd. Batavorum, 1655), a volume of front matter (dedication to the curators of the Neomagum gymnasium, note to the reader), then 34 numbered dissertations on Gelderland, Dutch and German history, the Jesuit doctrine of tyrannicide, Denmark, Hungary, Nassau, Cleves, Mexico, political theory, Seianism, academies, America and the Saracens, closed by a finis and a topical index of matters; the numeral XXX is printed twice.
